TASK: Rewrite `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app._index.tsx` to use React Polaris components instead of `<s-*>` web components.

IMPORTANT: The app already has PolarisAppProvider set up in app.tsx with i18n and CSS. All React Polaris components are available.

MIGRATION RULES — Replace every `<s-*>` component with its React Polaris equivalent:
- `<s-page heading="X">` → `<Page title="X" backAction={{ onAction: () => navigate("/app") }}>` (NO backAction on dashboard)
- `<s-section heading="X">` → just use `<BlockStack gap="600">` or `<Layout.Section>` as container
- `<s-box padding="base" borderWidth="base" borderRadius="base">` → `<Card>`
- `<s-stack direction="block" gap="base">` → `<BlockStack gap="400">`
- `<s-stack direction="inline" gap="base">` → `<InlineStack gap="400">`
- `<s-heading>` → `<Text as="h2" variant="headingMd" fontWeight="bold">`
- `<s-text>` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">`
- `<s-text color="subdued">` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd" tone="subdued">`
- `<s-text tone="neutral">` → `<Text as="p" variant="bodyMd" tone="subdued">`
- `<s-badge tone="success">X</s-badge>` → `<Badge tone="success">X</Badge>`
- `<s-button variant="primary" href="/app/X">` → `<Button variant="primary" url="/app/X">`
- `<s-button onClick={fn}>` → `<Button onClick={fn}>`
- `<s-banner tone="info" heading="X">` → `<Banner tone="info" title="X">`
- `<s-divider />` → `<Divider />`
- `<s-link href="/app/X">` → `<Button variant="plain" url="/app/X">` or use `<Link>` from react-router
- `<s-unordered-list>` + `<s-list-item>` → `<List>` + `<List.Item>`
- `<s-clickable onClick={fn}>` → wrap with `<div onClick={fn} style={{cursor:"pointer"}}>` or use `<Button variant="plain">`
- `<s-button slot="primary-action">` → use `<Page primaryAction={{content:"X", url:"/app/X"}}>` prop instead

For responsive grids of stat cards, use `<InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 4 }} gap="400">`.

IMPORTS needed:
```typescript
import { useNavigate } from "react-router";
import {
  Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Badge, Button,
  Banner, Box, Divider, InlineGrid, ProgressBar, List,
} from "@shopify/polaris";
```

The ProgressBar component replaces the custom `<div>` progress bar:
```typescript
<ProgressBar progress={value} tone={danger ? "critical" : "highlight"} size="small" />
```

KEEP: All loader logic, data fetching, types, helper functions unchanged. Only rewrite the JSX component rendering.

Read the current file first, understand its structure, then rewrite the entire default export function using React Polaris components. Make sure every `<s-*>` element is replaced. The file should have ZERO `<s-` elements when done.

After rewriting, verify by searching for any remaining `<s-` tags in the file.

| `<s-divider />` between chart rows | `<Divider />` |

The aside columns (plan, quick links, help) are now rendered inside `<Layout.Section variant="oneThird">` as stacked `<Card>` blocks, which is the standard Polaris two-column layout pattern.
